crew.overview: The story of a precocious six year-old and her ragtag group of friends whose summer break is filled with childhood wonder, possibility and a sense of adventure while the adults around them struggle with hard times.
crew.title: The Florida Project

details.biography: Andrew Duncan is the award-winning movie producer of Lord of Tears and Operator; and the producer of: Thoroughbreds, Fun Mom Dinner, Wildlife, Dude and Book Club. He also produced Joshua: Teenager vs. Superpower and The Florida Project, both of which received Oscar nominations. The movie Joshua also received the 2017 Sundance Film Festival Audience Award.  This tells the true story of Joshua Wong leading the pro-democracy movement in Hong Kong.
details.name: Andrew Duncan
